rationale: The `createInvoiceObject` function calls `time.Now()` at line 117 (`currDate := time.Now()`), which captures the current system time. This value is then formatted and used in date comparison logic (lines 119-121) that determines the `status`, `state`, and `delayPenalty` fields. These computed fields are written into the response buffer (lines 145-165) which is returned via `shim.Success()` at line 103 in `getInvoiceAmountById`. Since `time.Now()` is non-deterministic across endorsers and directly influences the proposal response payload, this constitutes a C1 TIME_NOW vulnerability that will cause endorsement divergence.
